pitch-to-build.description: Pulse pitches, Lead plans, Architect designs the top pitch, Builder builds it. The build lands in the review queue.

stages.instruction:
Andrew's instruction: {input}
Pulse's ranked pitch list is at {out:pulse}. Take the top pitch. This pipeline runs Architect then Builder next; plan their work and say what lands in the review queue.
Design the top-ranked pitch in {out:pulse}. Follow Lead's plan at {out:lead}.
Build the design at {out:architect} as a Rojo project in a new folder under projects/. Follow Lead's plan at {out:lead}. Keep the first build small: the core loop and the first 60 seconds only.

improve-build.description: For an existing game: Architect designs a change, Builder builds it in the project, Playtest reports on it. Lands in the review queue.

stages.instruction: Existing game in {project}. Read its docs and code only as needed. Task: {input}. Write the design change as design.md (sections as your skill says; describe the change against what exists now).
Implement the design change at {out:architect} in the existing project {project}. Do not restructure what you do not need to touch. First line of build.md: Project: {project}
Test the change described in {out:architect} and built per {out:builder} in {project}. Focus on the first 60 seconds. Report specific problems.
